test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under the NITI Aayog SDG India Index overall State and UT scores are generated from goal-wise scores to measure aggregate performance of the sub-national unit based on its performance across the 16 SDGs. Based on these scores, States/UTs are categorised in four categories. Which of the following is NOT one of the categories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Excellent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__

__
 
• The **SDG** India Index determines goal-wise scores for each **State and Union Territory** on the 16 SDGs.
 
• In order to assess the sub-national unit's overall performance across the 16 SDGs, **overall State and UT scores** are created using **goal-wise scores.**
 
• These **scores range** from** 0-100, **and if a State or UT receives a 100, it means it has met the **2030 targets.**
 
• The closer a State/UT comes to achieving its goal, the **higher its score.**
 
• Following is a **classification** of States and Union Territories based on their **SDG** **India** **Index** **scores**:
 
 
• **Aspirant:** 0–49
 
• **Performer: **50–64
 
• **Front-Runner:** 65–99
 
• **Achiever: **100
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **SDG** **India** **Index** 2020-21, created in partnership with the UN in India, monitors the performance of all States and UTs on 115 indicators that are in line with the **National Indicator Framework for MoSPI (NIF).**
 
• The need to regularly benchmark performance, measure progress, and take into account the availability of the most recent SDG-related data for **States and UTs** have driven the initiative to hone and improve this **crucial** **tool** with each edition.
 
• Multiple talks with **Union** **Ministries** were conducted as part of the selection procedure for these **115 indicators.**
 
• All States and UTs were asked for feedback, and as the primary audience and stakeholders for this **localization** **tool**, they were crucial in **creating the** **index** by adding local knowledge and experience to the feedback process.
